naming-fixture.text: Four separate fixture fields: optional payment destination, control address, next-control commitment, and retirement quorum. No economic policy.

profile-registry.text: identity.json lists generic and naming profiles. Existing generic file hashes stay byte-identical.

claim-and-observation.text: Two pending claims may share a spelling. Observation is unauthenticated, absent, active, or pending.

demo-spelling.text: alice maps to one frozen natural-number key as a demo fixture.

generic-preservation.text: The generic theorem inventory, corpus, statements, and model files remain byte-identical.
